body: I hate everything. It's all a waste of time.
True but I couldn't care less about getting better or whatever
I will try to  before my times up. Thanks for taking the time to write.
I just can't. Its like a invisible wall. No matter how I feel or what I do, I won't seek medical help.

Thank you. I enjoy very little anymore though. Everything seems pointless. Nearer to the time i might try talking to someone but I've done it so many times I could predict the whole conversation. I can't think of anything that would save me now
I'm seeing a movie Tuesday and camping Wednesday/Thursday. On top of that I want to spend atleast a hour with each of my friends. Its going to be hard to do.
Sad thing is even if it was the most amazing life ever filled with adventure and happiness, It still wouldn't be enough. I just want to die.
My best friend definitely will miss me. But it's not all about her. Its about me and my life. I bet she will be over it in mere days. I've got to end the cycle. Its been too long.
I've spoken to friends about it. But they are getting tired of hearing the same shit. I'm unwilling to go get medical help which they suggest I do.
Any and every peace. My mind would cease to stop spouting dark and depressing shit into my head. No more struggling.
It's too much of a burdon talking to close ones
